description_zh: 调用ListDomains接口查询加速域名与状态
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-domains --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --domain www.example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --state active --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDomains

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name that you want to query
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ICP filing status of the accelerated domain name that you want to query. Valid values:

illegal: The domain name is illegal.
inactive: The domain name has not completed ICP filing.
active: The domain name has a valid ICP filing.
unknown: The ICP filing status is unknown
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的加速域名ICP备案状态。取值：
illegal：违规。
inactive：未备案。
active：已备案。
unknown：未知
parameters.name: state

Domains.description_en: A list of accelerated domain names

items.description_en: The list of accelerated domain names

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance

Name.description_en: The name of the GA instance

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the GA instance.

This parameter takes effect only if ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the GA instance is managed. Valid values:

true: The GA instance is managed.
false: The GA instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that you can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter takes effect only if ServiceManaged is set to True.

You can perform only specific actions on a managed instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create: Create an instance.
Update: Update the current instance.
Delete: Delete the current instance.
Associate: Reference the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance.
CreateChild: Create a child resource in the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener.
IpSet: acceleration region.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule.
Endpoint: endpoint.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group associated with a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: traffic policy of an endpoint associated with a custom routing listener.

This parameter takes effect only if Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified actions are managed. Valid values:

true: The specified actions are managed, and you cannot perform the specified actions on the managed instance.
false: The specified actions are not managed, and you can perform the specified actions on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The ICP filing status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

illegal: The domain name is illegal.
inactive: The domain name has not completed ICP filing.
active: The domain name has a valid ICP number.
unknown: The ICP filing status is unknown
State.description_zh:
加速域名的ICP备案状态。
illegal：违规。
inactive：未备案。
active：已备案。
unknown：未知

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
